gaps.sentence: They would have won the match if their best player ___ injured.
gaps.hint: unreal past needs the past perfect
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition requires the past perfect: had not been.

gaps.sentence: If you had watered the plants, they ___.
gaps.hint: negative unreal past result with would
gaps.explanation: The unreal past result takes 'would not have' plus the past participle: would not have died.

gaps.sentence: As long as you ___ the rules, you will have no problems here.
gaps.hint: as long as states the condition
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' introduces the condition and takes the present simple: follow.

gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: He wishes he ___ harder at school when he had the chance.
gaps.hint: past regret, wish plus past perfect
gaps.explanation: Regret about past behavior takes the past perfect after 'wish': had worked.

gaps.sentence: I will note the reference number in case I ___ it later.
gaps.hint: in case means as a precaution
gaps.explanation: 'In case' describes a precaution and takes the present simple: need.

gaps.sentence: Take some sun cream in case the weather ___ hot.
gaps.hint: in case plus present, a precaution
gaps.explanation: 'In case' is followed by the present simple even with future meaning: turns.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ how to play the piano.
gaps.hint: wish plus past for present regret
gaps.explanation: 'Wish' plus past simple expresses regret about a present situation: knew.
